LanguageData.HH.Casino.AddictedText: {0} has played one session too many and is now addicted to gambling. Without regular play the withdrawal will wear on {PAWN_objective}: bad mood and, in the deeper stages, gambling sprees. You can change what {PAWN_nameDef} may do in the drug policy (the row "gambling").

LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Title: The Lucky Thrumbo
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Tagline: Orbital tables of the Silverline world. The house is in orbit; your stake is on the ground.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Comm.Info: An orbital casino that takes real silver and gives it back when it feels like it.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Card.Text: Slots, roulette and blackjack against a foreign house, with real silver from your account or from storage. Every round is sealed: reloading does not change it.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Card.Net: {0} rounds so far, {1} silver in total
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.EdgeLine: House edge: slots {0} % payout · roulette {1} % · blackjack about {2} %
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.EdgeTip: The edges are the exact maths of the casino games, plus a shift of {0} points from the difficulty setting (mod settings, Casino, Lucky Thrumbo). The house never cheats; it only has the edge it shows here.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.FromBankTip: Stakes leave your Silverline account, winnings go back onto it.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.FromSilverTip: Stakes are taken from silver in storage or in range of a trade beacon (whole coins). Winnings are handed to the colonist at the table; a fraction of a coin stays with the house until it adds up.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.LimitTip: One stake is at most {0} % of your net worth (account plus silver at home, minus debts), never less than {1} and never more than {2} silver. You can change this in the mod settings.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.VolTip: Same payout in the long run. Hit rate {0} %, best prize {1} times the stake.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Paytable: Paytable (pays back {0} % in the long run)
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Sealed: Your stake is sealed. Reloading the game does not change the result.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.BJ.Rules: Rules: {0}, endless deck.\nEdge with perfect play: {1} % at the standard odds, {2} % at yours.\nA shift is applied to winning hands (they pay ×{3}); worse play than perfect moves the edge a little less.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.TotalsGoods: Goods stakes (value in silver, not in the ledger): {0} rounds · staked {1} · paid back {2} · result {3}
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.NoMap: There is no colony to pay from.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.NoBank: You need a Silverline account to pay from it.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.NoPlayer: A colonist has to sit at the console to receive silver.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.Max: The table limit is {0} silver per stake.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.Whole: Silver from storage is staked in whole coins.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.FundsBank: Your account holds less than {0} silver.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.FundsSilver: There is less than {0} silver in storage or in range of a trade beacon.

LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.NoBet: Pick a bet on the board first.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Err.NoDouble: You can only double down on your first two cards.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.ButtonTip: Stake goods, animals or prisoners instead of silver. They are valued by the house's pawnbroker.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Title: Raise the stakes
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Intro: Put things on the table instead of silver. Lose, and they leave with the house as if you had sold them. Win, and you keep everything and the house pays out in silver.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.ValuedBy: Valued with the prices {0} gets (trade price improvement {1}).
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.NoNegotiator: Nobody on this map can negotiate a price.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.NoBeacon: No powered orbital trade beacon: no goods in reach.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.PawnsCozy: Animals and prisoners can be staked from the content intensity Standard on.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Empty.Goods: Nothing in range of a powered orbital trade beacon that a trader would buy.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Empty.Animals: No colony animal could be handed over right now.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Empty.Prisoners: No secure adult prisoner. Colonists, slaves, children and guests are never stakes.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.UnitTip:
Sell price: {0} each
− pawnbroker spread {1} %
− fee {2} %
= stake value {3} each
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.ToPodTip: Silver arrives in drop pods at the trade drop spot. A fraction of a coin stays with the house until it adds up.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Rule: Win ×m: keep everything and get value × (m − 1) in silver. Lose: the things are gone, as if sold. A small prize below ×1 is paid in silver, the things are still gone.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.GoRoulette: Stake it and spin the wheel
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.GoSlots: Stake it and pull the lever
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Confirm: Stake {0} (worth {1}) on one round?\n\nIf you lose, they are gone for good.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Won: pays ×{0}: you keep everything and win {1}
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Lost: lost: the stake leaves with the house
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.LostPart: lost, {0} paid back: the stake leaves with the house
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Err.Off: "Raise the stakes" is switched off in the mod settings.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Err.NoNegotiator: A colonist who can negotiate has to be on the map.
LanguageData.HH.Thrumbo.Stakes.Err.Gone: {0} is no longer in reach. Refresh the list.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.raiseTheStakes.Desc: Adds the button "Raise the stakes…" to the Lucky Thrumbo: stake goods in range of a powered orbital trade beacon instead of silver, and from the content intensity Standard also colony animals and prisoners (like vanilla selling). Colonists, slaves, children and guests are never offered.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.pawnbrokerSpread: Lucky Thrumbo: pawnbroker spread for staked goods
LanguageData.HH.Setting.thrumbo.pawnbrokerSpread.Desc: Staked goods count for what the house's pawnbroker would pay (the vanilla sell price with your best negotiator) minus this spread and a fixed 2 % fee.
